decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered: 

30676-PL-103 G, 30676-PL-104 E, 30676-PL-105 I, 30676-PL-106A, 30676-PL-107A, S02-14-055-013 Rev B, Building Services Plant Noise Assessment and covering letter dated 21/11/2014 received on 21/11/2014 and Tree Retention and Protection Plan 1408/13 02 Rev G, Proposed Landscape Layout 1408/13 03 Rev G and 30676-PL-102 K received on 11/02/2015 and documents as received under 00315/G/P1: 30676-PL-100B, 30676-PL-101A, Flood Risk Assessment and Drainage Strategy (Ref: R/13822/001 Issue 2 dated 5/12/2013), Design and Access Statement (Ref: 30676 dated December 2013), Planning Statement (Ref: Q40360 dated December 2013), Transport Assessment (Ref: MAC / 13113 dated December 2013), Phase I Geo-environmental & Geotechnical Desk Study and appendixes A-E (ref: R/13850/G001), Noise Assessment (ref: A085647 dated December 2013), Air Quality Assessment (Ref: 60312038 dated December 2013), Energy Statement (dated 12 December 2013), and Soft Landscape Design Statement and Maintenance and Management Plan (Ref: 1408/13/RP01 dated 13 December 2013) and appendixes including drawings: 1408/13/01 -Tree Constraints Plan), Bird Hazard Management Plan (Ref: 131201-ED-01b dated 13/12/2013 version 3) received on 16/12/2013,

therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of units hereby approved shall be implemented in accordance with submitted plans (30676-PL-107A and 30676-PL-105 I received on 21/11/2014)

Condition : 4 - Details of lux levels, direction and screening of any floodlighting shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 5 - Hard and soft landscaping (as set out in the approved Soft Landscape Design Statement and Maintenance and Management Plan (Ref: 1408/13/RP01 dated 13 December 2013) and appendixes including drawings: 1408/13/01 -Tree Constraints Plan received 16/12/2013 and Tree Retention and Protection Plan 1408/13 02 Rev G, Proposed Landscape Layout 1408/13 03 Rev G received on 11/02/2015 and boundary treatment shall be implemented in the first planting season following practical completion of the development in accordance with submitted plans unless otherwise agreed in writing

Condition : 6 - Landscape management shall be implemented in accordance with the Soft Landscape Design Statement and Maintenance and Management Plan (Ref: 1408/13/RP01 dated 13 December 2013) and appendixes including drawings: 1408/13/01 -Tree Constraints Plan received on 16/12/2013 and Tree Retention and Protection Plan 1408/13 02 Rev G, Proposed Landscape Layout 1408/13 03 Rev G received on 11/02/2015 hereby approved for the period of 10 years unless otherwise agreed in writing

Reason.  In the interest of biodiversity, sustainability, and to ensure that a satisfactory standard of visual amenity is provided and maintained in accordance with policy ENV-B.1.1 (New development) of the adopted UDP.

Condition : 7 - The proposed cycle parking, as approved under application ref: 00315/G/P1(7,20,21,24), car parking (including electric car charging points and disabled parking) and new accesses shall be implemented prior to occupation in accordance with approved plans unless otherwise agreed in writing

Condition : 8 - The approved Bird Hazard Management Plan (Ref: 131201-ED-01b dated 13/12/2013 version 3) shall be implemented prior to occupation in accordance with submitted plans unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - No construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 10 - The Construction Management Plan and Construction Logistic Plan as approved under application ref: 00315/G/P1(11) shall be adhered to throughout the construction process.
Condition : 11 - Prior to occupation details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a Delivery and Serving Plan.
Condition : 12 - No goods or materials shall be stacked or stored within the areas outside the buildings, unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 13 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant, other than those shown on the approved plans, shall be installed without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 14 - No servicing including service vehicle parking and the loading or unloading of operational vehicles shall take place to the south of Unit 1 (as labelled on approved plan 30676-PL-102 K received on 11/02/2015)
Condition : 15 - The access point from Aerodrome Way (as labelled on approved plan 30676-PL-102 K received on 11/02/2015) shall not be used to service Units 1 or 2

Condition : 16 - The office floorspace contained within the development hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the main use of the premises as B1(c), B2 or B8 class use and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 17 - The units hereby approved shall be used for B1(c), B2 or B8 use and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class B of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).

Condition : 18 - Unless otherwise approved with the Local Planning Authority in writing, the development shall not be completed other than in accordance with the details set out in the approved Energy Statement (dated 4 February 2014) prior to the occupation of any part of the development hereby permitted, and thereafter maintained and retained as such. Prior to occupation, details shall be submitted to and approved by the LPA to demonstrate that the 44% carbon emission reduction has been achieved.

Condition : 19 - Surface water drainage for the site shall not be implemented other than in accordance with the details as approved under application ref 00315/G/P1(7,20,21,24) before the development is completed.
Condition : 20 - The proposed development shall not take place other than in accordance with the remediation strategy as approved under application ref 00315/G/P1(7,20,21,24).

Condition : 21 - If, during development, contamination not previously identified is found to be present at the site then no further development (unless otherwise agreed in writing with the local planning authority) shall be carried out until the developer has submitted a remediation strategy to the local planning authority detailing how this unsuspected contamination shall be dealt with and obtained written approval from the local planning authority. The remediation strategy shall be implemented as approved.

Condition : 22 - The approved Phase I Desk Study Report, Preliminary Factual and Historical Data Report, Phase 2 Ground Investigation Report and Remediation Method Statement as approved under application ref 00315/G/P1(7,20,21,24) shall be adhered to during the course of the development. 
   During the course of the development:
a.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
b.	The agreed scheme for decontamination as approved under application ref 00315/G/P1(7,20,21,24) and referred to in clauses c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
description: Amended Description: Variation of condition 2 (detailed plans) of planning permission 00315/G/P1 for revised plans depicting the amendments to Unit 1, Unit 2 and additional plant equipment to the rear of Unit 1 and to include the previous amendments made under approved NMA (00315/G/P1(NMA1).
